songs.title: Go Out in Peace
songs.author: Demo Writer
songs.firstLine: Go out in peace, go out in joy,
songs.words: Go out in peace, go out in joy, carry the light wherever you go; hearts made new and hands made strong, love is the road we walk along. Go in peace, go in joy, go with love. Amen.

songs.title: Morning Lantern
songs.author: Demo Writer
songs.firstLine: Wake, my soul, the dawn is breaking,
songs.words: Wake, my soul, the dawn is breaking, light is spilling through the door; every shadow now is fading, You are faithful evermore. Like a lantern in the morning, You go on ahead of me; every step and every turning lit by grace I cannot see. Sing aloud, the day has come, all the earth, a joyful song; from the morning till it's done, we will praise You all day long.

songs.title: Quiet Harbor
songs.author: Sample Songwriter
songs.firstLine: When the storm is loud around me
songs.words: When the storm is loud around me and the waves are rising high, You are still the quiet harbor, You are shelter for the night. When my strength has all been given and my sails are torn and thin, You will call the wind to silence, You will gently bring me in. Rest, my heart, rest, my heart, anchored deep in love; though the sea is wild and dark, You are calm above.

songs.title: River of Mercy
songs.author: Demo Writer
songs.words: There's a river running deep, wide enough for all who seek; cool and clear it calls my name, I will never be the same. River of mercy, carry me home, over the valley and over the stone; river of mercy, flowing so free, wash every worry away from me. When the summer fields are dry, when the dust is in my eyes, I will kneel beside the stream, You restore the soul in me.

songs.title: Sing, O Hills
songs.author: Demo Writer
songs.firstLine: Sing, O hills, and clap, O trees,
songs.words: Sing, O hills, and clap, O trees, shout it on the morning breeze; oceans roar and rivers run, tell what wonders He has done. Lift it high, lift it loud, let the song rise past the clouds; every mountain, every sea, sing with us in harmony. Stars that shine and birds that fly, every color in the sky; we will join the song they bring, lift our voices, lift and sing. Sing with us in harmony. (x2)

songs.title: Steady Ground
songs.author: Placeholder Hymnwriter
songs.firstLine: When the path is hard to follow
songs.words: When the path is hard to follow and the evening hides the way, You are steady ground beneath me, You are with me night and day. When the years have turned to winter and my hands no longer hold, You will keep me, You will lead me, You are faithful as of old. When at last the road is ended and the light of morning streams, I will stand on steady ground, fuller than my brightest dreams.

songs.title: The Table Is Set
songs.author: Sample Songwriter
songs.words: Come, the table is prepared, bread is broken, cup is shared; none too far and none too small, there is room here for us all. Bring the hunger, bring the thirst, bring the last and bring the first; all who wander, all who roam, welcome to the family home. We remember, we receive, in this moment we believe; grace for every empty place, we are gathered by Your grace.

songs.title: When the Day Is Done
songs.author: Placeholder Hymnwriter
songs.firstLine: When the day is done and the lamps burn low,
songs.words: When the day is done and the lamps burn low, when the stars come out and the cool winds blow, I will lay me down where the quiet grows, resting in Your care. All the words I said and the work I've done, all the race unfinished and the battles won, I will leave them here at the setting sun, resting in Your care. Hold me through the night, wake me with the light; every breath I take, resting in Your care.
